t.E282.agn: In 2014 EFSA stated that the data did not allow an acceptable daily intake (ADI) to be set, but that there would be no safety concern at the authorised uses and maximum levels.
t.E282.body: It is converted to propionic acid in the body; this fatty acid is also produced by gut bacteria and is used for energy metabolism.
t.E282.prod: Mostly produced by chemical synthesis from petrochemical raw materials; its salts are obtained by neutralising the acid.
t.E282.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no ADI could be set, no safety concern at authorised use levels.
t.E282.summary: The calcium salt of propionic acid. It is the most commonly used mould inhibitor in packaged bread.
t.E282.what: It is a preservative that delays mould growth in bread and bakery products.
